text: A society that relies only on meritocratic rewards destroys its own meritocracy: Price's Law differentiates rewards exponentially, the bottom tier cannot afford the training to compete, and the separation widens until the society destabilizes and collapses.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Transcendental Unifying Values for Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782220
